correctness.rationale: Exactly fixing the partner of marked endpoint 1 leaves N=2n−2 labeled endpoints in a uniform perfect matching. Choosing h across-cut pairs yields p_{n,k}(h) from binomial choices, h! bijections and two internal double-factorial pairings, supported on h≡k mod2. Dividing k+2 and k pmfs yields [(k+2)(k+1)(N−k−h)]/[(N−k)(N−k−1)(k+2−h)]; the derivative in h has sign N−2k−2>0, with extra mass at top h=k+2, proving strict MLR and stochastic order for each same-parity step. For adjacent k≥1, parity at zero and opposing top tails (including ratio (N−2k)/(N−k)<1 for even k) prevent either first-order ordering; k=0→1 is deterministic. Direct indicator expectation k(N−k)/(N−1) increases across allowed adjacent k. Independently enumerated all labeled pairings through 12 endpoints and verified every conditional mass; the infinite assertion uses counting/inequalities rather than enumeration.
